finalists.label: Invasive Fungal Sinusitis
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including granulomatous mucosa and a heterogeneous, focally hyperdense lesion.

finalists.label: Sinusitis
finalists.why: It has the broadest range of general symptoms, including nasal obstruction, purulent discharge, and opacification of sinuses.

finalists.label: Chronic Sinusitis
finalists.why: It explains the chronic nature of the symptoms and the lack of improvement with antibiotics.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of granulomatous mucosa and a heterogeneous, focally hyperdense lesion specifically supports Invasive Fungal Sinusitis over the more general Sinusitis.
